mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 1% for two consecutive months reduces near-term discounting of corporate cash flows, lowering the present value of future earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% and remains >1% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: tightening phase of the Fed funds rate
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified tightening window (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months coincides with increased consumer caution, suppressing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% and remains below for three consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market loosening preceding recessionary fears
failure_condition: 20-day rolling average 60-day forward returns are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05) during the low-unemployment period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% for two months indicates strengthening supply-side momentum that raises investor confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO grows by >2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the identified expansion period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 3% for four consecutive months suggests the Fed is less likely to raise rates, lowering discount rates and supporting higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 3% for four consecutive months
regime_hint: deflationary pressure in inflation targeting regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the CPIAUCSL condition (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 with FEDFUNDS below 2% creates a dual signal of labor strength and policy easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200,000 for two consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS < 2%
regime_hint: labor market expansion under loose monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) during the combined signal period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% triggers a risk-on sentiment shift as market anticipates job growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% and remains below for two consecutive months
regime_hint: early signs of labor market tightening
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales proxy (assumed from available proxies, but none directly available; thus omitted) — instead, using HOUST (housing starts): A two-month decline in new residential construction (HOUST) suggests cooling real estate demand, which suppresses equity risk appetite and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
Note: Since no direct retail sales proxy exists, this sketch uses HOUST as a demand proxy for housing. Adjust if needed for available proxies.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls for two consecutive months below previous month's value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the housing decline.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (assumed from available proxies, using GDPC1 as a demand proxy but here interpreted as supply shock via output gap logic): A 3-month drop in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates supply-side weakness, lowering growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for three consecutive months
regime_hint: prolonged supply contraction in economic cycle
failure_condition: 60-day rolling average of 20-day forward returns is positive (p < 0.05) during the INDPRO decline.
